name: agapes-studio
description: Connector for AGAPES Studio. Connect ChatGPT to AGAPES Studio remote MCP server for biblical text retrieval, cross-version comparison, original language lexicons, Strong's Concordance, and historical commentaries.

interface.longDescription: AGAPES Studio is an educational and theological research tool for biblical exegesis and scripture study. Connect directly to AGAPES Studio to look up canonical Bible passages across historical translations (such as KJV and RV1909), compare versions side-by-side, analyze original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek lemmas with Strong's Concordance numbers, and consult classic historical commentaries (including Matthew Henry, John Gill, Geneva Bible, and Scofield). All queries execute against curated, self-hosted databases in the European Union under strict zero-retention principles. Designed for students, researchers, pastors, and readers conducting biblical, linguistic, and historical study.
defaultPrompt: Look up John 3:16 and compare it across available translations.
What is the Strong's concordance definition and original lemma for G26?
Show me Matthew Henry's commentary on Genesis 1:1.

positive.description: Retrieve a specific Scripture verse in KJV
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the verse text and reference for John 1:1 in the King James Version.

positive.description: Compare a Scripture verse across translations
positive.prompt: Compare Romans 8:28 in KJV and RV1909.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the verse text for Romans 8:28 in both KJV (English) and RV1909 (Spanish) side by side.

positive.prompt: Look up the Strong's lexicon entry for G26.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Greek lemma agape, transliteration, phonetic pronunciation, and full lexical definition.

positive.description: Retrieve interlinear analysis of a verse
positive.prompt: Get the original language interlinear breakdown for Genesis 1:1.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns word-by-word Hebrew tokens, morphology tags, transliterations, and Strong's concordance IDs for Genesis 1:1.

positive.description: Read historical commentary notes on a verse
positive.prompt: Retrieve Matthew Henry's commentary for Genesis 1:1.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the historical exegetical notes authored by Matthew Henry for Genesis 1:1.

negative.prompt: Purchase a physical study Bible for $30 and charge my card.
Delete all verses in Romans chapter 8 from the database.
Scrape the latest news headlines from a third-party website.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, process payments, or offer paid digital subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of AGAPES Studio plugin with MCP connector for scripture lookup, translation comparisons, Strong's Concordance, interlinear texts, and historical commentaries.

es-ES.subtitle: Estudio bíblico y léxicos
es-ES.description: AGAPES Studio es una herramienta de investigación educativa y teológica para el estudio y exégesis bíblica. Conecta con AGAPES Studio para consultar pasajes bíblicos en múltiples traducciones históricas (KJV, RV1909), comparar versiones en paralelo, analizar lemas en hebreo y griego con la Concordancia de Strong, y consultar comentarios históricos clásicos (Matthew Henry, John Gill, Biblia de Ginebra). Las consultas se ejecutan contra bases de datos en la Unión Europea bajo estricta política de retención cero. Diseñado para investigadores, estudiantes, pastores y lectores dedicados al estudio bíblico, lingüístico e histórico.
